purpose: Reviewer queue for approving or rejecting admin create, update, archive, and delete requests before data-changing work is applied.
businessRules: No archive or permanent delete should be completed from normal admin pages without a submitted change request appearing here.
Review actions use CHANGE_REVIEWER ACL and idempotency keys.
Payloads are displayed for auditability before approval.
Backend network failures and backend API 404 responses render AdminApiUnavailable instead of the Next runtime overlay.
